* '''Errata 2, current full face''' ([[Luke's Blaster Pistol (V) (Errata 2)]]): rerender published in [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6489b69cc5f1545e5e24ac7b2d68ae446cf03769 commit 6489b69], committed 2022-07-10T19:39:59Z.
